AgriDesign: design and analysis of agricultural experiments

Source: R/AgriDesign-package.R
AgriDesign-package.Rd

Analysis of variance of the classical agricultural designs with the right error strata, least-squares means, assumption checks, mean separation, figures, reports and randomised field layouts. Base R only.

Details

Start with designs() to see the designs available and design_anova() to analyse one.
